title: LLMSeg: Training-Free Text-Prompted Image Segmentation with B-Splines
title_zh: LLMSeg：基于B样条的免训练文本提示图像分割

paragraphs.en: 提出免训练的LLMSeg流水线，用多模态大模型加B样条实现文本提示图像分割，性能媲美SAM 3。 Promptable segmentation models such as SAM 3 achieve remarkable open-vocabulary performance but require dedicated architectures, large-scale annotation engines, and task-specific training. We ask a different question: can a general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) segment images directly, without an added segmentation head, mask decoder, or training? We present LLMSeg, a training-free pipeline that turns a vision-capable LLM into a text-prompted image segmenter. LLMSeg decomposes segmentation into three LLM-driven stages. First, detect localizes all instances matching a free-form text query and describes their coarse morphology. Next, segment traces each instance using closed periodic B-splines confined to its detected box. These splines define an outer boundary and optional hole loops. Finally, refine iteratively proposes focus boxes around residual errors and retraces confined splines. The process ends when the mask stabilizes or the pass budget is exhausted. The output is a binary mask with inspectable intermediate geometry. We evaluate LLMSeg across ten referring and reasoning segmentation splits (ReasonSeg and RefCOCO/+/g). We also evaluate open-vocabulary instance segmentation (LVIS, COCO, and SA-Co), semantic segmentation, and zero-shot detection (ODinW13 and RF-100VL). With an off-the-shelf Gemini-3.7-Flash backend, LLMSeg is competitive with and often surpasses the specialist SAM 3 model on identical items. It reaches 71.5 cIoU on ReasonSeg val without additional segmentation-specific training. Backend model updates can improve accuracy without retraining the pipeline. The code is available at https://abdullahamdi.com/llmseg .
paragraphs.zh: 提出免训练的 LLMSeg 流水线，用多模态大模型加 B 样条实现文本提示图像分割，性能媲美 SAM 3。诸如 SAM 3 之类的可提示分割模型取得了卓越的开放词汇性能，但需要专门的架构、大规模标注引擎和针对任务的训练。 我们提出一个不同的问题：通用的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能否直接分割图像，而无需额外的分割头、掩码解码器或训练？ 我们提出 LLMSeg，这是一个免训练的流水线，能将具备视觉能力的 LLM 变成文本提示的图像分割器。 LLMSeg 将分割分解为三个由 LLM 驱动的阶段。 首先，检测阶段定位所有匹配自由文本查询的实例，并描述它们的粗略形态。 接着，分割阶段使用限于其检测框内的闭合周期 B 样条来描绘每个实例。 这些样条定义了外边界和可选的孔洞环路。 最后，精化阶段迭代地围绕残余误差提出聚焦框，并在框内重新描绘样条。 当掩码稳定或遍数预算耗尽时，该过程结束。 输出是一个带有可检查中间几何结构的二值掩码。 我们在十个指代和推理分割数据集划分（ReasonSeg 和 RefCOCO/+/g）上评估 LLMSeg。 我们还评估了开放词汇实例分割（LVIS、COCO 和 SA-Co）、语义分割以及零样本检测（ODinW13 和 RF-100VL）。 借助现成的 Gemini-3.7-Flash 后端，LLMSeg 在相同条目上与专门的 SAM 3 模型相当，且常常超越它。 它在 ReasonSeg 验证集上达到 71.5 cIoU，且无需额外的分割专用训练。 更新后端模型可以在不重新训练流水线的情况下提升精度。 代码可在 https://abdullahamdi.com/llmseg 获取。
